ambiguities.text: The index page lists modules but does not specify initialization order or dependencies between modules.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume modules can be loaded in any order and have no circular dependencies. This is a standard assumption for Python module systems.

implicit_assumptions.description: All required cryptographic libraries and dependencies are available in the execution environment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Fork activation would fail, potentially causing consensus split if some nodes have dependencies and others do not.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork.py module correctly implements all Cancun consensus rule changes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Blocks valid under Cancun rules might be rejected or invalid blocks might be accepted, causing chain split.
